findings.text: non-blocking: DEFAULT_PERTURBATION sets flux_fraction 0.02, the axis-flux band's own bound, so the published perturbed-copy axis-flux cell is marked FAIL on a 1.6e-15 excess (receipt.json:138 reads 0.020000000000001638) and the table prints "0.02 of span FAIL"; the done-when's "ranked worse" holds robustly but the every-band FAIL rests on float rounding rather than a declared margin.

non-blocking: map_boundary re-implements the largest-closed-flux-contour capability owned by nova/imas/profiles.py:56 closed_plasma_boundary, which already walks descending edge fractions of a stored grid and returns the largest closed loop; the addition duplicates that owner rather than extending or wrapping it.

non-blocking: read_equilibrium_wall re-implements the limiter-ring read from a wall IDS owned by nova/equilibrium/wall_mask.py:209 wall_units_from_ids, duplicating the owner rather than extending or wrapping it and diverging from it on multi-description IDSs and closure flags.

non-blocking: _polygon_area is a fourth shoelace area in nova after nova/imas/diiid_machine_ids.py:196 _shoelace_area and nova/equilibrium/separatrix_clip.py:102 _signed_area, and it duplicates _loop_area added at benchmarks/estimator_scoreboard.py:139 in the same change.

non-blocking: the new bands cite docs/figures/inverse-equilibrium-baseline/efit-on-nova-rows/receipt.json, whose band keys are axis_metres, current_fraction, flux_fraction and q95, while the registry states plasma_current_fraction, axis_flux_fraction, boundary_flux_fraction and q95_difference, so the evidence pointer cannot be resolved key-for-key and MetricTolerance.field was widened to ScorecardField | str to carry names outside the registered vocabulary.

non-blocking: read_equilibrium_state reads equilibrium.time without checking ids_properties.homogeneous_time, so a non-homogeneous IDS raises IndexError at times[index] instead of the module's EfitRefereeError, against the repository's rule that homogeneous_time is checked on every IMAS read.

non-blocking: assert state.q95 == -1.5 compares the reader's echo against the -1.5 the test handed read_equilibrium_state on line 356, so it holds for any scoring regression and fails only if the reader rewrites its own argument.

non-blocking: the committed receipt records its states under the worker's run directory (~/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261114T143301237025-estimator-scoreboard/states) and cases.json:20 names ~/.cache inputs, both removed or machine-local, so the digest-naming receipt cannot be re-opened or the table regenerated from the committed artefacts alone.
